description: This file defines the BuyingController class and related functions for managing purchase-related operations in an ERP system, including validation, asset management, stock ledger updates, and integration with other modules.

classes.name: QtyMismatchError
classes.description: Custom exception class for quantity mismatch errors.

classes.name: BuyingController
classes.description: Main class for handling purchase operations, including validation, asset management, stock ledger updates, and related business logic.

methods.name: get_feed
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with supplier name, currency, and grand total for display.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of the purchase document, including item validation, stock checks, and subcontracting rules.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Sets additional data when the document is loaded, such as backflush settings.

methods.name: set_missing_values
methods.description: Sets default values for missing fields, including supplier details and item info.

methods.name: set_supplier_from_item_default
methods.description: Assigns default supplier based on item defaults if not already set.

methods.name: validate_stock_or_nonstock_items
methods.description: Adjusts tax categories if all items are non-stock items.

methods.name: update_tax_category
methods.description: Updates tax category to 'Total' and displays a message.

methods.name: validate_asset_return
methods.description: Checks if asset return conditions are met and assets are not linked.

methods.name: get_asset_items
methods.description: Returns list of item codes marked as fixed assets.

methods.name: set_landed_cost_voucher_amount
methods.description: Calculates and sets landed cost amounts for items.

methods.name: validate_from_warehouse
methods.description: Validates warehouse selections for items.

methods.name: set_supplier_address
methods.description: Sets display addresses for supplier and shipping addresses.

methods.name: set_total_in_words
methods.description: Converts total amounts into words for display.

methods.name: update_valuation_rate
methods.description: Calculates valuation rates for items based on taxes and costs.

methods.name: set_incoming_rate
methods.description: Sets incoming rates for items based on valuation and transfer type.

methods.name: get_supplied_items_cost
methods.description: Calculates total cost of supplied items for a given reference.

methods.name: validate_for_subcontracting
methods.description: Validates subcontracting-related fields and conditions.

methods.name: create_raw_materials_supplied
methods.description: Creates raw materials supplied records if subcontracted.

methods.name: sub_contracted_items
methods.description: Property that returns list of sub-contracted item codes.

methods.name: set_qty_as_per_stock_uom
methods.description: Converts item quantities to stock UOM and validates conversion factors.

methods.name: validate_purchase_return
methods.description: Ensures rejected quantities are not entered in purchase returns.

methods.name: validate_rejected_warehouse
methods.description: Validates rejected warehouse entries for items.

methods.name: validate_accepted_rejected_qty
methods.description: Validates that received quantity equals accepted plus rejected quantities.

methods.name: validate_negative_quantity
methods.description: Checks that quantities are not negative unless in a return.

methods.name: check_for_on_hold_or_closed_status
methods.description: Checks if linked documents are on hold or closed.

methods.name: update_stock_ledger
methods.description: Updates stock ledger entries based on item quantities and warehouses.

methods.name: update_ordered_and_reserved_qty
methods.description: Updates quantities on purchase orders based on receipt or invoice.

methods.name: make_sl_entries_for_supplier_warehouse
methods.description: Creates stock ledger entries for supplier warehouse transactions.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions on document submission, including fixed asset processing.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions on document cancellation, including asset deletion.

methods.name: validate_budget
methods.description: Validates expenses against budget.

methods.name: process_fixed_asset
methods.description: Creates fixed assets if applicable.

methods.name: auto_make_assets
methods.description: Automatically creates assets for items marked for auto creation.

methods.name: make_asset
methods.description: Creates an asset document for a given item row.

methods.name: update_fixed_asset
methods.description: Updates or deletes linked assets based on document status.

methods.name: delete_linked_asset
methods.description: Deletes linked asset records.

methods.name: validate_schedule_date
methods.description: Validates and sets schedule dates for items.

methods.name: validate_items
methods.description: Validates item types for purchase or subcontracting.
